Class CurrentOrderModel

java.lang.Object
model.CurrentOrderModel
public class CurrentOrderModel extends Object
Model class for managing the current order, including drinks, toppings, associated prices, IDs, and checkout procedures. This class provides methods for adding items to the order, clearing the order, refreshing the display of the current order and total price, and handling the checkout process, including updating inventory quantities and inserting order details into the database. It ensures that the current order is accurately represented and that all necessary database operations are performed to finalize the order.

      public List<OrderLineDTO> get_lines()

    • get_total

      public BigDecimal get_total()
      Calculates and returns the total price of the current order by summing the prices of all order lines. This method iterates through the list of order lines, retrieves the price of each line, and accumulates the total using BigDecimal for accurate monetary calculations. The total price is returned as a BigDecimal, allowing for precise representation of currency values.
      Returns:
      A BigDecimal representing the total price of the current order.

    • add_item

      public void add_item(OrderLineDTO line)
      Adds a new item to the current order and refreshes the display to reflect the updated order details and total price. This method takes an OrderLineDTO object representing the item to be added, appends it to the list of order lines, and then calls the refresh_display() method to update the current order and total price properties for UI display.
      Parameters:
      line - The OrderLineDTO object representing the item to be added to the current order.

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Clears the current order by removing all items from the order lines list and refreshing the display to show an empty order and a total price of zero. This method is typically called when the user confirms the cancellation of an order or when the order is completed and needs to be reset for a new transaction. This method also calls refresh_display() to update the current order and total price properties for UI display, ensuring that the user sees an accurate representation of the cleared order.

    • refresh_display

      public void refresh_display()
      Refreshes the display of the current order and total price based on the items in the order. This method constructs a string representation of the current order, including item details and total price, and updates the current_order and order_total properties for UI display. If the order is empty, it sets the current_order property to "Item1: " and the order_total property to "Total: 0.00".

    • find_drink

      private MenuDrinksRowDTO find_drink(String name)
      Finds a drink by its name in the menu database and returns its corresponding MenuDrinksRowDTO. This method queries the database for drinks matching the provided name and returns the first matching result. If no drinks are found, it returns null. If multiple drinks are found with the same name, it throws an IllegalStateException.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the drink to be searched in the menu database.
      Returns:
      The MenuDrinksRowDTO corresponding to the found drink, or null if no drink is found.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if multiple drinks are found with the same name.

    • find_topping

      private MenuToppingsRowDTO find_topping(String name)
      Finds a topping by its name in the topping menu database and returns its corresponding MenuToppingsRowDTO. This method queries the database for toppings matching the provided name and returns the first matching result. If no toppings are found, it returns null. If multiple toppings are found with the same name, it throws an IllegalStateException.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the topping to be searched in the topping menu database.
      Returns:
      The MenuToppingsRowDTO corresponding to the found topping, or null if no topping is found.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if multiple toppings are found with the same name.

    • decrement_drink_ingredients

      private void decrement_drink_ingredients(int drink_id)
      Decrements the inventory quantities of the ingredients used in a drink when an order is placed using information from the join table that links drinks to their ingredients. This method retrieves the list of edible ingredient IDs associated with the specified drink ID and decrements their quantities in the edible inventory. If any ingredient cannot be updated, an IllegalStateException is thrown to indicate a failure in updating the inventory.
      Parameters:
      drink_id - The ID of the drink for which the ingredient quantities need to be decremented in the inventory.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if any ingredient cannot be updated in the inventory.

    • checkout

      public boolean checkout(BigDecimal tip_rate, boolean discard)
      Checks out the current order by inserting each order line into the database, updating inventory quantities for drinks and toppings, and applying a tip rate to the total price. This method ensures that all necessary database operations are performed to finalize the order. It handles both normal checkout and special cases where the order is discarded without consuming ingredients. If the order is empty, or required non-edible items are unavailable, an IllegalStateException is thrown.
      Parameters:
      tip_rate - The tip rate to be applied to the total price of the order, represented as a BigDecimal.
      discard - A boolean flag indicating whether the order is being discarded (true) or completed (false). If true, the order will be logged with a "discard" status and no ingredients will be consumed.
      Returns:
      True if the checkout process is successful, indicating that all order lines were processed and inserted into the database without errors.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the order is empty, required non-edible items are unavailable, or if any inventory updates fail during the checkout process.
